name: Minimal Assumption Preservation Audit Registry
purpose: Verify that future modifications do not silently increase foundational assumptions and maintain the core set of restricted local constraints.

assumption_audit_checks.finding: Core assumption count remains at exactly three classes (A1-A3).
No introduction of infinite scales or universal reaches detected.
Relational identity remains context-bounded by neighborhood bounds.
Mandatory loss is still declared in all modification candidates.
Strict neighborhood quantifier qualification is maintained.

governance_rules.rule: Every assumption expansion requires an explicit 'ASSUMPTION_INFLATION_JUSTIFICATION' file.
